name: Before the Darkness: Between Us
source:
The soulbond was supposed to save you. Instead, it's killing you both.

Bound to Suguru Geto soul to soul, you thought the hardest part was over. But the bond is rotting — cursed energy born from obsession, not love. As your body breaks down and curses swarm around you, there's only one solution: Satoru Gojo.

His power can purify the bond, but the method requires pushing Geto's jealousy to its limit. Gojo's hands on your skin, and the way Geto watches, torn between fury and something darker. The line between saving your life and losing yourself blurs with every touch.

Can the three of you survive what this ritual demands? Or will jealousy, desire, and a corrupted bond destroy everything you've built?

[From [url=https://khywae.itch.io/before-the-darkness-between-us]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
灵魂纽带本来可以拯救你。相反，它正在杀死你们俩。

与Suguru Geto灵魂相连，你以为最困难的部分已经过去了。但这种联系正在腐烂——这种被诅咒的能量源自痴迷，而不是爱。当你的身体崩溃并被诅咒包围时，只有一个解决方案：五条悟。

他的力量可以净化羁绊，但方法需要将盖托的嫉妒推到极限。五条的手抚摸着你的皮肤，还有下图看着你的方式，他在愤怒和更黑暗的东西之间挣扎。拯救你的生命和失去你自己之间的界限随着每一次触摸而变得模糊。

你们三个能顺利完成这个仪式吗？或者嫉妒、欲望和腐败的纽带会摧毁你所建立的一切吗？

[来自[url=https://khywae.itch.io/before-the-darkness-between-us]Itch.io[/url]]
